entries.text: 這裡就是米莫莎的\n新醫務室嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_first_01

entries.text: 啊，我就知道是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n叫我來的～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_00

entries.text: 突然被告知要出差，\n害我超～驚訝的。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_01

entries.text: 而且我第一次教課竟然不是在學院，\n而是在這裡呢～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_02

entries.text: 加油！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 妳可以的
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_select_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那是從哪兒來的自信！？\n我才是需要自信的人呀……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_03b

entries.text: 不過，難得[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳都\n給我這個機會了……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_04

entries.text: 米莫莎的醫務室，出差版！\n我就做給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳看吧！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_05

entries.text: 我的第一堂課\n被我搞砸了……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_01

entries.text: 上課的過程\n一切都很順利喔？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_02

entries.text: 可是我弄錯了教室，\n教的是別的班級～！！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_03

entries.text: 那還真糟糕
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 偶爾也是會發生這種事的！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 我進到了大家都在自習的教室，\n擅自上起了健康教育課，\r\n真是成了個十足的可疑份子～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_04

entries.text: 不……怎麼可能？\n有人安慰我，我是很開心，\r\n但在學院也不會發生這種事吧？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_04b

entries.text: 啊～我不想再說這個了！\n想起來就覺得丟臉！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_05

entries.text: 討厭的事就忘了吧，\n只要記住下次別再犯就是了！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_06

entries.text: 我之前不是在錯的班級\n上了課嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_01

entries.text: 結果那一班有好幾個孩子\n都跑來問我問題喔！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_02

entries.text: 雖然對我來說，弄錯班級這件事\n是不堪回首的黑歷史……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_03

entries.text: 但是對於那些孩子來說，\n似乎並不是毫無意義的。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_04

entries.text: 我覺得……\n開心得不得了呀～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_05

entries.text: 太好了！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 真不得了呀！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 是不是～真的是這樣！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_06

entries.text: 當老師果然很開心呢。\n當然有時也會很辛苦就是了。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_07

entries.text: 因為我總是受到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的照顧……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_01

entries.text: 所以我們用交換寶可夢，\n讓彼此更～接近好不好？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_02

entries.text: OK～\n我會選好壞星，\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要選哪隻呢？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]呀，不錯嘛。
超～有[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的風格喔。\c
既然是我來負責照料，
我會將牠培育得健康又茁壯的！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_04

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_02_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的同行寶可夢只有１隻，\n所以不能交換喔。\r\n請帶２隻以上再來吧～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_03_00

entries.text: 欸～講真的嗎？\n拒絕我，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可是會吃虧的喔～？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_03_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想用寶可夢交換，\n讓我們彼此更～接近了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_04_00

entries.text: 怎麼了，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]？\n難道是想和我對戰嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_talkto_00

entries.text: 一副想打的樣子，結果不打啊！\n好吧～我沒差。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_cancel_00

entries.text: 好呀～反正我也有空。\n就讓我陪陪[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳吧。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 小孩子總是全力以赴，\n真是不～得了呀……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 而且[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳又特別地強，\n應該要多放點水的呀～！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 既然[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打贏我了，\n我就教[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能拍出網美照的姿勢吧。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 雖然這應該勉勉強強\n還不算俗氣……\r\n但後果請自行負責囉～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]從米莫莎老師那裡\n學會了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]額頭比耶表情[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_reward_00

entries.text: 好了，緊急處置完成……\n這個[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也拿去吧。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 不要太過拼命，\n搞得自己受傷喔～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 咦？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳終～於學會\n怎麼放水了呀？\c\n看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也稍微長大一點了呢～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳用過巨蛋裡的回復機嗎？\c\n那東西好像可以自己操作來回復體力呢～\n總覺得好懷念呀～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 這個學園是不是沒有醫務室？\c\n那大家想蹺課的時候，\n都會去哪裡呀？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
備課真是
挺～辛苦的耶……\c
學院的各位老師們
都能不叫苦就完成，真是厲害～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]活力太充沛了，\n讓我幾乎招架不住！\r\n講真的，和某人一模一樣。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我的好壞星很棒吧？
而且牠的特性還很罕見呢。\c
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要好好地培育牠，
讓牠可以上台表演喔～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_04
